questions.prompt: In triangle ABC, AB = AC. Prove that ∠B ≅ ∠C using a rigid motion: the reflection across the bisector of ∠A.

questions.required_method: Explain where the reflection sends ray AB, point B, and point C.
questions.grading_note: Any valid explanation. Essential: the reflection across the bisector of ∠A swaps rays AB and AC (the bisector makes equal angles with them); B goes to the point of ray AC at distance AB = AC, which is C; so B ↔ C and the triangle maps onto itself with ∠B ↔ ∠C.
